description: A delicious 5-day food trip to Tokyo, exploring local street food, mastering Japanese cooking, and experiencing vibrant night markets.

accommodation.amenities: restaurant, spa, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast included

days.title: Arrival and Ginza Street Food Exploration
days.description: Arrive in Tokyo, check into your hotel, and immediately dive into the local food scene with a street food walking tour in Ginza.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll explore the vibrant streets of Ginza and discover various local food stalls and eateries. What to bring: Wear comfortable shoes as you'll be walking, and bring an appetite for diverse flavors. What to eat: Expect to sample a range of Japanese street foods, from savory snacks to sweet treats. Good to know: This tour is a great introduction to Tokyo's culinary landscape and local customs.

days.title: Morning Cooking Class and Afternoon Relaxation
days.description: Learn to cook traditional Japanese dishes in a morning class, followed by a relaxing afternoon at a wellness spa.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll learn to prepare authentic Japanese dishes under the guidance of a local chef. What to bring: Just bring your enthusiasm for cooking and an empty stomach to enjoy your creations. What to eat: You'll get to eat the delicious Japanese meal you prepare during the class. Good to know: This hands-on experience offers insight into Japanese culinary techniques and ingredients.

What you'll see: You'll experience a tranquil half-day at a wellness and spa center, offering relaxation and rejuvenation. What to bring: Bring comfortable clothing, swimwear if applicable, and any personal toiletries you prefer. What to eat: Light refreshments or tea may be available, but this activity focuses on relaxation rather than a meal. Good to know: This is a perfect way to unwind and recharge after exploring the city.

days.title: Historic Sights and Evening Tapas Crawl
days.description: Explore Tokyo's rich history with a walking tour, then immerse yourself in the vibrant night market and tapas scene.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll discover historic landmarks, traditional temples, and significant cultural sites in Tokyo. What to bring: Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring a camera to capture the beautiful scenery. What to eat: This tour focuses on history and culture, so plan for meals before or after the activity. Good to know: A great way to understand the historical context of modern Tokyo.

What you'll see: You'll experience the lively atmosphere of a Tokyo night market and sample various tapas-style dishes. What to bring: Bring cash for small purchases and an open mind for new culinary experiences. What to eat: You'll enjoy a variety of small plates and snacks from different vendors. Good to know: This is a fantastic opportunity to mingle with locals and experience Tokyo's nightlife.

days.title: Premium Street Food and Sunset Cruise
days.description: Indulge in a premium street food tour in Shinjuku, followed by a scenic sunset cruise on Tokyo Bay.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Street Food Walking Tour — Premium Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll explore Shinjuku's culinary hotspots and taste a curated selection of premium street foods. What to bring: Wear comfortable shoes and be ready to try a variety of local delicacies. What to eat: Expect to sample high-quality street food items, potentially including more gourmet options. Good to know: This tour offers a more refined street food experience in one of Tokyo's bustling districts.

What you'll see: You'll enjoy breathtaking views of the Tokyo skyline as the sun sets over the bay. What to bring: A light jacket might be useful, and a camera for stunning photo opportunities. What to eat: Light snacks or drinks may be available for purchase on board, but this is not a meal-focused activity. Good to know: A romantic and picturesque way to see Tokyo from a different perspective.

days.title: Morning Cooking Class and Departure
days.description: Enjoy a final cooking class in Shibuya before heading to the airport for your return flight.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll learn to prepare traditional Japanese dishes in a hands-on cooking class with a local chef. What to bring: An eagerness to learn and an appetite to enjoy the meal you prepare. What to eat: You will dine on the delicious Japanese cuisine you've cooked during the class. Good to know: This is a great opportunity to take home new culinary skills and recipes.
